title: VoiceStudio packages local voice cloning, dubbing and transcription
friendlyTitle: VoiceStudio runs many voice AI tools on your own computer
summary: VoiceStudio is an actively developed, AGPL-licensed desktop platform for local voice generation, cloning, dubbing, transcription, dictation and audiobook workflows. The repository has about 13,600 stars and supports a broad collection of optional speech engines and models.
friendlySummary: This popular open project combines voice creation, cloning, dubbing, transcription and audiobook tools in one desktop app.
whyItMatters: Creators and developers can test an end-to-end voice workflow on their own hardware instead of sending every recording to a hosted service. Review the license and each downloaded model's terms, and never clone a person's voice without clear permission.
friendlyWhyItMatters: It can keep more audio work local. Check model licences and only copy a voice when the person has clearly agreed.
